Based on my inspection of the implementation and tests, here is my review.

```json
{
  "verdict": "pass",
  "blockers": [],
  "non_blocking_notes": [
    "Proposal registry is effectively write-only inside the loop: repo_goal_loop never calls registry.mark(..., 'promoted') (only tests do at tests/test_proposal_registry.py:90), and check_lineage()/pending_for_prompt() are not wired into the loop. The planner's 'promoted_in_registry' skip (arena/proposal_planner.py:170) therefore never triggers during a run, and the live diff runner is always passed pending_proposals=() (arena/repo_goal_loop.py:587). Dedup-after-promotion relies entirely on re-decomposition/scorecard, not the registry. Additionally proposal_key embeds base_head_oid, so any record written before a promotion is keyed off a HEAD that no longer matches post-promotion. This is bookkeeping divergence, not a safety hole.",
    "Multi-path candidates (ComponentVerificationDomain can emit target_paths with >1 .py file) fail closed but cannot make progress: in live_diff, DiffProposerRunner._single_target_path raises 'diff proposer requires exactly one target file' (arena/runners/diff_proposer.py:347) every cycle; in deterministic mode _deterministic_apply only fixes target_path (the first), so _promote's exact-set check set(staged)!=set(target_paths) (arena/repo_goal_loop.py:752) refuses promotion. Safe, but such findings can never promote and a streak can trip the divergence halt.",
    "_requires_source_references now hard-returns True (arena/proposal_planner.py), so every docs candidate gets the --require-source-references gate. The deterministic _generate_doc omits a '## Source references' section when the repo has no README.md (arena/repo_goal_loop.py:658), so docs candidates verify-fail (fail closed) on README-less repos and can contribute to a divergence halt.",
    "Markdown auto-repair (_unique_suffix_match / _collapsed_repeated_prefix_match) can rewrite a broken link to an unintended-but-existing file that then passes link validation (quality risk, not safety). On repair-then-still-failing, _reverse_diff reverses only the original diff (arena/runners/diff_proposer.py:205) and may not cleanly undo the repair edits, but the worktree is isolated and torn down, so nothing leaks into the baseline.",
    "agent_wiki secret rejection is best-effort: the api_key/secret patterns require '<key><sep>' with no intervening quote, so JSON-serialized key names like \"api_key\":\"...\" are not matched (only inline 'token=...'-style values are). Acceptable as defense-in-depth on values.",
    "The loop uses git worktrees in every mode, but only live_diff validates git/goal-config presence (_validate_live_config). A non-git target in deterministic mode would raise out of _apply_and_verify rather than fail gracefully; production targets are git repos so this is an operational precondition, not a run blocker."
```
